Project Kickoff Checklist - Merger Integration

Before the kickoff meeting

  • Invite the steering committee and the two workstream leads.
  • Book the board room and video bridge for 90 minutes.
  • Distribute the integration plan draft:
    • IT landscape inventory (owners, SLAs, sunset dates).
    • HR onboarding timeline for transferred staff.
    • Legal checklist for data processing agreements.
  • Collect open questions from the Q&A channel:
    • License terms for the legacy ERP add-ons.
    • Office consolidation decision for the Hamburg site.

During the meeting

  1. Confirm the integration principles and the escalation path.
  2. Walk through the plan section by section:
    1. Week 1–2: environment freeze and access provisioning.
    2. Week 3–4: data migration dry runs.
    3. Week 5–6: cutover, shadow run, and sign-off.
  3. Agree on the weekly status cadence (Mondays, 09:00).
  4. Assign owners for every open action item.

After the meeting

  • Publish the minutes within two working days.
  • Open the tracker and file every action item.
  • Schedule the first weekly status meeting.

Note: ordered lists render with bullet markers in this build; the decimal numbering is not implemented. Nested lists indent via padding-left on ul/ol.
